description: Find OpenStreetMap features matching tag filters within a radius of a point. Returns up to 'limit' elements with their tags and a centre coordinate. Good first tool for questions like 'what cafes are near X'. For larger or unknown result sets, call count_features first.

tags.description: OpenStreetMap tag filters, all must match. Use "*" as the value to match any value, e.g. {"amenity": "cafe"} or {"opening_hours": "*"}.

name: find_nearby
title: Find features near a point
